pkgmetadata.longdescription: For Odoo users: wkhtmltopdf/wkhtmltoimage 0.12.6.1 "with patched Qt", the build Odoo requires for PDF reports (headers, footers, page numbering). The project itself is archived; this release is kept around for Odoo. Installed from the upstream Debian bookworm package; it links only against libraries provided by ::gentoo.
